At 6th level you learn Gnashing Fang, Savage Claw, and Wicked Talon. At 12th level you learn Fated Circle and Fated Brand. At 14th level you learn Double Down. These are automatic class actions; they do not use class feat slots. Follow-ups require Continuation.

Requirements Your Keen Edge combo opening.

Make a melee gunblade Strike. On a hit, regain Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1), and gain that many temporary Hit Points until the end of your next turn. This healing and barrier can occur only once per round. After resolving the Strike, consume the opening and enable Solid Barrel until the end of your next turn.

Cost 1 cartridge.

Make a melee gunblade Strike. On a hit, deal additional fire damage: 1d6 at 1st level, 2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, and 4d6 at 17th. If you have Continuation, a hit enables Hypervelocity as your next action this turn against the same target.

Once per encounter, when Solid Barrel or Demon Slaughter would load 1 cartridge, you may load 2 instead. A single finisher can load no more than 2 cartridges.

You learn Hypervelocity, Jugular Rip, Abdomen Tear, and Eye Gouge. Matching follow-ups: Burst Strike → Hypervelocity; Gnashing Fang → Jugular Rip; Savage Claw → Abdomen Tear; Wicked Talon → Eye Gouge.

After a successful Burst Strike, Gnashing Fang, Savage Claw, or Wicked Talon, you may use its matching follow-up as your next action on the same turn against the same creature, provided it remains within your melee reach. Any intervening action, including a free action, closes the opening. Reactions do not close it. The opening ends at the end of your turn or when consumed. Only one Continuation follow-up, including Fated Brand, can be used per round.

Hypervelocity, Jugular Rip, Abdomen Tear, and Eye Gouge each cost 1 action and deal 2d6 fire damage plus the number of weapon damage dice of the gunblade used for the opening Strike. The dice become 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17. Snapshot the weapon dice when the opening Strike resolves. The follow-up has no attack roll or save, does not increase MAP, and never doubles on a critical opening Strike. It is a separate damage effect for immunity, weakness, and resistance. No Mercy and weapon property-rune damage do not add to it.

Fated Brand retains its existing damage, fresh basic Reflex saves, eligible-target restrictions, and shared Continuation limit. It receives no weapon-dice bonus. Its opening follows the same intervening-action rule.

After resolving the saves, end the combo and load 1 cartridge, even if all targets succeed. At least one enemy must be in the area.

Gunnhildr's blades protect their companions with aetheric wards, then unleash explosive sword combinations. This PF2e Remaster playtest adapts the FFXIV job's identity to three-action turns.

Initial Proficiencies

Key attribute Strength or Dexterity; 10 + Constitution modifier HP per level. Trained Perception, expert Fortitude, trained Reflex and Will. Trained simple weapons, martial weapons, unarmed attacks, light and medium armor, unarmored defense, and Gunbreaker class DC. Trained Athletics plus 3 + Intelligence modifier additional skills. Use the d6 finesse Light Gunblade for a Dexterity build, or the d8/two-hand d12 Gunblade for Strength.

You gain standard attribute boosts at levels 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20, ancestry feats at 1/5/9/13/17, class feats at 1 and every even level, skill feats at every even level, general feats at 3/7/11/15/19, and skill increases at every odd level starting at 3. Skill proficiency is capped at expert before level 7 and master before level 15.

During exploration, your alertness and Athletics help you escort companions and clear dangerous routes. Outside battle, you may be a bodyguard, weaponsmith, or keeper of Gunnhildr's traditions. There are no mandatory religious edicts.

Playtest and Tracker

Read RULES.html for the complete class and PLAYTEST.md for balance assumptions. Use the Gunbreaker Tracker macro; recording an action is separate from posting its rules to chat. Roll and apply attacks, saves, and damage normally. Old world copies must be replaced using MIGRATION.md.

You learn Keen Edge, Brutal Shell, Solid Barrel, Burst Strike, Demon Slice, and Demon Slaughter at 1st level. All these actions require you to wield a gunblade. Combo actions can be used only in a combat encounter with a genuine threat.

You can maintain one combo sequence at a time. Keen Edge opens Brutal Shell, which opens Solid Barrel. Demon Slice opens Demon Slaughter. Each step consumes the previous opening and enables the next until the end of your next turn. Advance the sequence after resolving the action, even on a miss. Starting another sequence replaces the old one. Other actions, including movement, defense, normal Strikes, and cartridge spenders that do not start a sequence, do not interrupt it.

All Strikes use and increase multiple attack penalty normally. Bonus damage belongs to the Strike and doubles on a critical hit unless specified otherwise. Count only the base weapon damage die and fundamental striking rune dice when a feature refers to weapon damage dice; extra dice from abilities or property runes do not count. No Mercy modifies gunblade Strike damage, not separate save-based blasts or Continuation damage.

Trigger: An ally other than you within 15 feet would take damage from a successful enemy attack roll, including a critical success. Requirements: You wield a gunblade and can see the ally and attacker. The ally gains resistance to all damage from the triggering attack equal to 2 + half your level, rounded down. Before applying the resistance, you may spend 1 cartridge to increase it to 2 + your level. This includes Strikes and spell attacks. Saving-throw effects and automatic damage without a successful attack roll do not trigger it.

Protection applies to damage resolved as part of that triggering attack, not later persistent-damage ticks or separate follow-up actions. Apply the current PF2e immunity, weakness, and resistance rules once per applicable effect; never turn the resistance into an extra subtraction after native resistance. Aetheric Ward, Bulwark Protocol, Guardian’s Instinct, and Lion’s Legend continue to modify this reaction as written.

Your gunblade stores aether in a Powder Gauge with a maximum of 3 cartridges. At the start of a combat encounter, begin with 1 cartridge; unspent cartridges dissipate at its end. You cannot build cartridges outside a combat encounter with a genuine threat, as determined by the GM. A training target or cooperative creature is not a threat.

Completing Solid Barrel or Demon Slaughter loads 1 cartridge, even if the Strike misses or every target succeeds at its save. Each activity loads only once, regardless of targets. You cannot exceed your maximum. Costs are paid before resolving an action and are not refunded on a miss. Cartridges are class resources, not ammunition or trade goods. Round fractional values down, to a minimum of 1 only where stated.

Use the Gunbreaker Tracker macro to record cartridges, combos, and cooldowns. Posting an item to chat never spends or grants resources. Effects, attacks, saves, damage, healing, and reactions are resolved on the sheet with your GM.

Unless a feature says otherwise, you must wield a gunblade to use Gunbreaker actions and reactions. Passive features do not require this. Aurora and defensive abilities without an encounter requirement may be used during exploration; their cooldowns still apply.

You adopt the protective posture of Gunnhildr's guard. Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC while in this stance. Your damage is unchanged. The stance ends if you cease wielding a gunblade, become unconscious, or combat ends. Your Heart of Stone reaction works with or without the stance. This stance does not force enemies to attack you.

Apply the linked Royal Guard effect when you enter, and remove it when you leave.

During daily preparations, choose fire, cold, or electricity; fire is the default. Until your next daily preparations, replace the fire damage of Burst Strike, Hypervelocity, Jugular Rip, Abdomen Tear, Eye Gouge, Fated Circle, Fated Brand, Double Down, Saturation Fire, and Overpowered Round with the chosen type. This changes only those listed damage components. It does not change physical weapon damage, persistent bleed, property runes, Lightning Shot, Danger Zone, Bow Shock, Reign secondary damage, or Relentless Rush. Replace any corresponding fire trait on a modified effect with the chosen damage trait. Other traits and all costs are unchanged.

You can use Heart of Stone when you would take damage from an enemy's Strike, targeting yourself. You must spend a cartridge when using it this way. It uses the same reaction as Heart of Stone and provides its cartridge-enhanced resistance.

Frequency once per 10 minutes. Choose yourself or a living ally within 30 feet. The target gains fast healing equal to half your level (minimum 1) for 3 rounds, healing at the start of each of its next three turns. It is then immune to your Aurora for 10 minutes. Multiple Auroras do not stack. This is fast healing, not regeneration; it does not prevent death.

Aurora gains a second use per 10 minutes. Each target is still immune to your Aurora for 10 minutes after receiving it; spend the second use on a different target. Its healing does not otherwise increase.

Danger Zone deals d8s instead of d6s and has a range of 30 feet. It retains the same action cost and shares Danger Zone's once-per-10-minutes frequency; this is an upgrade, not a second blast.

It expires at the start of your next turn. You cannot use more than one reaction on the same triggering attack. Aetheric Ward cannot use this extra reaction.

Frequency once per day. Requirements You can act and wield a gunblade. You and allies currently within 30 feet gain resistance to all damage equal to your level until the start of your next turn. Recipients retain the benefit if they leave the area. This does not stack with other resistance to the same damage. You cannot activate it while unconscious or otherwise unable to take its two actions.

You become trained in Diplomacy and Escort Lore. If already trained in either, choose another skill in which to become trained for each duplicate. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Gather Information checks about route hazards, local security, or threats to a person or group you are escorting. The GM determines whether the inquiry qualifies. This benefit does not apply to initiative, combat checks, or unrelated information gathering.

Use the class setup workflow to apply the training choices once. The roll option covers only GM-approved Gather Information inquiries.

rules.label: Gunnhildr Escort: qualifying Gather Information inquiry

description.value: Frequency once per 10 minutes. Requirements You wield a gunblade. Choose yourself or an ally within 30 feet. Until the start of your second subsequent turn, the target gains resistance to all damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). After an instance of damage leaves it at or below half its maximum HP during this duration, it regains 2d8 + your level HP, then the healing portion ends. This healing triggers at most once, even if the target was already below half HP when you used the action. It cannot heal a dead creature. Untriggered healing expires with the resistance. Apply manually using the originating Gunbreaker's level and turn.

Frequency once per 10 minutes. You and allies currently within 15 feet gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against spells and resistance to damage from spells equal to half your level (minimum 1), until the start of your second subsequent turn. The resistance applies only to spells, not every magical ability. Recipients retain the benefit if they leave the area. Apply these situational benefits manually.

Make a ranged gunblade Strike with a range increment of 30 feet and a maximum range of 120 feet. Use Dexterity for the attack. Deal fire damage using the gunblade's one-handed base damage die and its runes; add specialization normally, but do not add Strength to damage. This does not consume a cartridge or require reloading. Normal ranged attack rules, including cover, multiple attack penalty, and reactions, apply. It does not advance a combo or grant Continuation.

You may use Lightning Shot while wielding a standard gunblade in one or two hands. Its weapon dice always use the one-handed base die, including fundamental striking dice. It uses Dexterity to attack, adds specialization, and adds no Strength damage. Apply only property runes whose own requirements permit that ranged attack; a discharge does not override a melee-only requirement. Lightning Shot does not grant a second weapon, transfer runes, require ammunition, or open Continuation. Keep its range and existing feat level.

Frequency once per 10 minutes. Gain resistance to all damage equal to half your level (minimum 1) until the start of your second subsequent turn. Apply Nebula. Overlapping resistances do not add together.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.bbf2b441d6c80fae]{Nebula}. Apply manually after recording the action.

Frequency once per 10 minutes.

For 3 rounds, until the start of your third subsequent turn, gain a +2 status bonus to gunblade Strike damage; this becomes +3 at 11th level and +4 at 17th. Load 1 cartridge immediately and gain Ready to Break for the same duration, allowing one Sonic Break if you have that feat. Apply No Mercy. This bonus does not affect Continuation or save-based blasts.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.698e269ba38bcb47]{No Mercy}. Apply manually after recording the action.

When Burst Strike hits, you may deal fire damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice to each other enemy within 5 feet of the primary target. This is separate secondary damage, not the splash weapon trait. It does not damage the primary target, you, or your allies; it does not double on a critical hit and does not occur on a miss. Aetheric Calibration may change this fire damage.

Frequency once per day. Requirements You wield a gunblade. For 1 minute or until the encounter ends, whichever comes first, reduce the cartridge cost of the first cartridge-spending action or reaction you use each round by 1 (minimum 0). You choose whether to apply the reduction when spending. This includes the optional cartridge enhancement to Heart of Stone. Costs otherwise apply normally, and cooldowns and combo requirements are unchanged. This does not increase cartridge generation.

Frequency once per encounter. After you critically hit a genuine enemy with a gunblade Strike, you may load 1 cartridge. This is not an action. You cannot use it on a training target or cooperative creature.

Requirements Ready to Reign from Bloodfest; you wield a gunblade. Consume Ready to Reign and begin the Reign sequence. Make a melee gunblade Strike with 2d6 additional slashing damage. On a hit, deal 2d6 fire damage to up to two other enemies that are both within your melee reach and adjacent to the primary target; each attempts a basic Reflex save against your class DC. The secondary damage does not depend on the primary Strike's critical result.

After resolving the Strike, enable Noble Blood until the end of your next turn. You may use only one Reign sequence action per turn. Strikes use and increase multiple attack penalty normally. The sequence does not grant Continuation.

Additional Strike damage @Damage[2d6[slashing]]; secondary @Damage[2d6[fire]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]
End your Royal Guard stance. This is a granted action, not a selectable class feat.
Frequency once per round. Immediately after completing Solid Barrel or Demon Slaughter, you may Step as a free action. This movement does not require the Strike to hit or a save to fail.

Frequency once per 10 minutes. Requirements You wield a gunblade. Enemies in a 5-foot emanation take 8d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. Gain resistance to all damage equal to half your level until the start of your next turn. At the start of your next turn, enemies then in a 5-foot emanation take 4d6 fire damage with a new basic Reflex save against your class DC. The second blast occurs only if you remain conscious and wielding a gunblade. Neither blast uses or increases multiple attack penalty.

@Damage[8d6[fire]], then @Damage[4d6[fire]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]

Frequency once per encounter.

When you use Heart of Stone to protect an ally other than yourself, you may apply its cartridge enhancement without spending a cartridge. You can do this with no cartridges remaining. It uses your normal available reaction, does not load a cartridge, and cannot enhance Aetheric Ward. Declare the use before resolving the protection. You cannot also apply Perfect Chamber’s discount to the same enhancement.

Cost 1 cartridge. Requirements: You wield a gunblade. Enemies in a 30-foot line attempt a basic Reflex save against your Gunbreaker class DC against 1d6 fire damage per 2 levels, rounded up. Allies are unaffected. This is not a Strike, does not use or increase MAP, and does not open Fated Brand. Aetheric Calibration may change its fire damage.

Requirements Ready to Break from your No Mercy; you wield a gunblade. Consume Ready to Break and make a melee gunblade Strike. On a hit, add 1d6 persistent bleed damage, increasing to 2d6 at 11th level and 3d6 at 17th. Double the persistent damage on a critical hit as part of the Strike. It uses normal recovery checks and does not open Continuation. The opening is consumed even if you miss.

@Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-5)/6))d6[persistent,bleed]]

Requirements: You are conscious, have at least 2 HP, and wield a gunblade. Lose HP equal to your level, but this loss cannot reduce you below 1 HP. This loss is not damage, cannot be prevented or redirected, and does not trigger damage-based abilities. Until the start of your next turn, gain resistance to all damage equal to twice your level. This does not prevent conditions, death effects, or damage exceeding your resistance. Normal dying rules apply if damage reduces you to 0 HP.

Requirements You wield a gunblade. Choose one enemy within 30 feet that can see you. Attempt to Demoralize it using Intimidation; your gunblade's threatening discharge replaces the auditory trait with the visual trait and removes the penalty for not sharing a language. All other Demoralize rules, including its immunity, apply. This is not a Strike and consumes no cartridge.

Frequency once per round. Requirements You wield a gunblade and can see an enemy or ally within twice your Speed.

Stride up to twice your Speed, ignoring difficult terrain but not greater difficult terrain. You must finish adjacent to the chosen creature and be able to reach a legal space; otherwise you cannot use this action. You cannot move through creatures or obstacles, and this movement triggers reactions normally. It does not include a Strike or interrupt your combo.

When Brutal Shell grants you temporary Hit Points, you may grant one adjacent ally the same number of temporary Hit Points until the end of your next turn. Temporary Hit Points do not stack. This can occur only once per round.
